title: Hennepin County Recorded Property Sales
description: Recent recorded property sales in Hennepin County, MN (Minneapolis and suburbs): sale price, sale month, deed type, address, property type, market value, year built and coordinates. Filter by city, ZIP, price or sale month.
why: Minnesota is a disclosure state, so the actual price paid is public. This reads the county's last recorded sale per parcel, newest first, which is the comp set appraisers and investors need.
useCases: Investors and agents pulling sold comps by city or ZIP
Appraisers and lenders checking sale-to-value ratios
Market reporters tracking prices month by month

minPrice.title: Minimum sale price (USD)
minPrice.description: Only sales at or above this price.

maxPrice.title: Maximum sale price (USD)
maxPrice.description: Only sales at or below this price.

limits: The county holds the LAST sale per parcel, so earlier sales of the same parcel are not returned.
Sale month (YYYYMM) is the county's precision.
